HOW WE TEACH A COURSE

From first conversation
to exam day.

  1. I.

    A conversation first.

    Tell us your course, exam year and where you want support. Your first online trial is free.

  2. II.

    A plan for your course.

    We map the syllabus, route and set texts to your exam year, then agree one-to-one or group lessons.

  3. III.

    Lessons that build understanding.

    Read, discuss and write in each lesson. A quotation is a beginning. What matters is how you explain it.

  4. IV.

    Practice, then the exam room.

    Practise writing, discuss your work and develop your exam technique and timing. Your exam centre handles entries.

THE WAY WE THINK ABOUT ENGLISH

Understanding
before answers.

A quotation is a beginning. The thinking you do with it is what matters.

English is more than a list of techniques or an essay formula. It asks us to notice carefully, find connections and explain what we mean.

I.

Read with attention. Notice the choices that shape meaning.

II.

Think with independence. Explore an idea and support your interpretation.

III.

Write with intention. Give each sentence a clear purpose.

Explore our teaching approach ↗

Questions parents ask.

How do I know which syllabus is right?+

Your school or exam centre confirms your syllabus code. You’ll find the code on every course card.

Do you enter students for the exams?+

Century Academy provides tuition. Your registered exam centre handles entry and coursework administration.

Are lessons one-to-one or group?+

Both formats are available online. We discuss which would suit the student.

How does the free trial work?+

Tell us your course and where you want support. Your first online trial is free.

How are fees charged?+

Tuition can be arranged hourly or monthly. Message us to discuss the fees for your course and lesson format.

Can you help students outside the GCC?+

Yes. We teach online across the GCC and worldwide.

THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE LESSONS

Experience that gives

Our teaching team includes English teachers with more than 20 years of experience. We offer online one-to-one and group classes, with the course and lesson format discussed around the student.
